test_case.test_name: GB-NV-PVP tray simulated-leak protective transaction — INTERFACE PENDING
test_case.purpose: Exercise the version-matched GB-NV-PVP tray's built-in leak simulation once and prove its own sensor, protective turn-off, BMC event and healthy restoration chain without real coolant or adjacent-platform evidence substitution.
required_package: GB-NV-PVP owner-approved controller/firmware identity and exact self-test interface
Platform-specific sensor, valve/pump, tray/power and BMC channel mapping
Expected assertion/deassertion values, sequence, timing and service-impact limits
Approved abort, reset/restoration and platform recovery procedure
test_case.test_command: DO NOT TRANSPOSE the row-2094 trigger or invent a generic action. After the GB-NV-PVP interface/oracle is signed, capture complete platform/controller/BMC baselines; with point approval invoke that supported simulation exactly once, preserve full status/output and record every mapped transient/protective/event transition; use only the documented platform restoration and prove all no-leak/actuator/service states normal. Never introduce PG25, filter evidence to matching lines or retry after anomaly.
test_case.expected_result: Cannot be finalized without the GB-NV-PVP response contract. The exact tray instance must accept the self-test, assert its defined simulated-leak state, execute the specified protective turn-off on time, emit the correct mapped BMC signals and return to the approved healthy no-leak state.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS while the platform trigger, turn-off target, signal/timing sequence and recovery are undefined. After unlock, PASS requires one version-compatible invocation and complete causal evidence for every specified assertion, protective action, event and restoration. FAIL on neighboring-platform substitution, wrong tray/channel, late/missing/extra response, real leak, service violation or restore failure.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until GB-NV-PVP firmware compatibility, command/oracle, service window and recovery are approved.
Require human point authorization before one simulation.
Verify simulation-only behavior, secret-safe access and complete evidence; do not introduce coolant or clear logs.
Abort without retry on physical leak, unexpected pump/valve/power state, BMC loss or failed restoration.
expected_evidence: Exact GB-NV-PVP source/variant/hash and comparison showing row-2094 evidence was not substituted
Tray/controller/BMC firmware inventory, signed trigger artifact and approval
Platform-specific sensor/actuator/power/channel response and timing matrix
Complete trigger request/response and timestamped unfiltered pre/during/post controller telemetry
Full IPMI/Redfish/SEL/EventLog assertion/deassertion evidence tied to the tray instance
Documented restoration to healthy no-leak state, post-health, no-coolant/no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: If platform identity, response or service state deviates, stop and preserve all evidence. Do not invoke an adjacent-platform command, add physical liquid or retry. Follow only the GB-NV-PVP recovery document and keep affected cooling controls/node isolated until owner release.
